title: Damage Limit Uplift by Case Age (FBN)
content:
A Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-damage case earns a damage limit uplift by its age: the long-wait damage uplift of 6 units for a case opened at least the long damage wait of 45 days before the handling date, the short-wait damage uplift of 3 units for a case opened at least the short damage wait of 21 days but fewer than 45 days before it, and no uplift for a newer case.

Age is counted in days from the moment the case was opened to the handling date.

```
case age in days
   0 ............ 20  | 21 ............ 44 | 45 and more
   no uplift          | 3 units            | 6 units
```

Boundary cases (hypothetical): a case 20 days old has no uplift; at 21 days it has 3 units; at 44 days still 3 units; at 45 days 6 units.
